verses.text: You really taking a dispute with another believer to court before people who don’t follow God, instead of letting God’s people handle it?
Don’t you know God’s people will judge the world? If you’ll judge the world, can’t you handle the small stuff?
Don’t you know we’ll judge angels? So surely we can sort out everyday matters.
If you’ve got disputes like these, why pick judges who have no standing in the church?
I’m saying this to wake you up: is there really nobody wise among you who can settle things between believers?
But instead, one believer sues another—and does it in front of unbelievers!
The fact you’re suing each other already shows you’ve lost the plot. Why not take the wrong? Why not accept being cheated?
No—you’re the ones doing wrong and cheating, and you’re doing it to your own family in faith.
Don’t you know people who do wrong won’t inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t let anyone fool you: the sexually immoral, idolaters, adulterers, male prostitutes, men who have sex with men,
thieves, greedy people, drunkards, slanderers, and swindlers won’t inherit God’s Kingdom either.
Some of you used to live like that. But you were washed clean, made holy, and made right with God in the name of the Lord Jesus and by the Spirit of our God.
“You can do anything,” some people say—but not everything is good for you. “You can do anything,” but I won’t let anything control me.
“They say, ‘Food is for the stomach, and the stomach is for food.’ God will bring both to an end. But the body isn’t for sexual immorality; it’s for the Lord, and the Lord is for the body.”
God raised the Lord from the dead, and by his power he’ll raise us too.
Don’t you know your bodies are parts of Christ? Should I take Christ’s parts and join them to a prostitute? Absolutely not!
Don’t you know that someone joined to a prostitute becomes one body with her? Scripture says, “The two will become one flesh.”
But the person joined to the Lord is one spirit with him.
Run from sexual immorality! Every other sin a person commits is outside the body, but sexual immorality is a sin against one’s own body.
Don’t you know your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit living in you, the Spirit you received from God? You don’t belong to yourself.
You were bought at a price. So honor God with your body and your spirit—they belong to God. 🙏
